title: Graph Valid Tree
prompt: Given n nodes labeled from 0 to n - 1 and a list of undirected edges, write a function to check whether these edges make up a valid tree. A valid tree has exactly n-1 edges and is connected.
hints: Tree: connected and no cycles. Need exactly n-1 edges. If edges.length != n-1, return false.
Union-Find: for each edge, if u and v already in same component, cycle - return false. Finally check single component.
Or DFS: if we see an already-visited node (that is not parent), cycle. Count visited nodes.
